data.name: Phillip
data.gender_notes: Phillip is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the New Testament of the Bible, Philip was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ. The name means 'friend of horses' or 'lover of horses' in both Greek and Hebrew. The name Phillip carries the meaning “Friend of horses” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Phillip usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of horses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Phillip belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of horses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Phillip total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: פיליפ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פיליפ הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ופירושו אוהב סוסים או חובב סוסים, השם נגזר מהמילים היווניות 'פילוס' (אוהב) ו' היפוס' (סוס), השם היה נפוץ בקרב היהודים והנוצרים ביוון ורומא העתיקות, והוא גם שם של אחד מתלמידי ישו

in_greek.name: Φίλιππος
in_greek.meaning: Φίλος ίππος, ο φίλος των αλόγων
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Φίλιππος είναι όνομα ελληνικής προέλευσης που σημαίνει φίλος ίππος ή ο φίλος των αλόγων, το όνομα προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'φίλος' (φίλος) και 'ίππος' (άλογο), το όνομα ήταν κοινό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και ήταν επίσης το όνομα ενός από τους μαθητές του Ιησού

in_latin.name: Philippus
in_latin.meaning: lover of horses or horse lover
in_latin.long_meaning: Philippus is a Latinized form of the Greek name Philippos, meaning lover of horses or horse lover, derived from the Greek words 'philos' (love) and 'hippos' (horse), the name was popular in ancient Greece and Rome and is also the name of one of Jesus' apostles

in_english.name: Phillip
in_english.meaning: lover of horses or horse lover
in_english.long_meaning: Phillip is a Christian name derived from the Greek name Philippos, meaning lover of horses or horse lover, originating from the Greek words 'philos' (love) and 'hippos' (horse), the name has significant biblical reference as one of Jesus' twelve apostles, and has been a popular name in Christian tradition, symbolizing strength, courage, and devotion

data.cultural_impact: Philip is known as the apostle who preached to the Ethiopian eunuch, leading to the spread of Christianity in Africa. In traditional African culture, the horse is considered a symbol of power, status, and strength. The phrase "Philip the Horseman" became synonymous with the powerful influence and impact of the Christian faith in Africam.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian faith, Philip is a symbol of spreading the message of Jesus Christ to all nations and peoples. He is remembered for his obedience and unwavering commitment to the Lord, as seen in his encounter with the Ethiopian eunuch. The name Philip serves as a reminder to boldly share the gospel with others, regardless of cultural or societal barriers.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Phillip, derived from the Greek name Philippos, means "friend of horses" or "horse-loving." Symbolically, it represents a strong connection to nature and companionship, reflecting the spiritual bond between humans and animals. In a spiritual sense, Phillip embodies the virtues of loyalty, strength, and humility, as depicted in the biblical character Philip the Apostle.

historical_references.reference: Phillip the Evangelist was one of the Seven Deacons in the early Christian church, mentioned in the New Testament.
